title: Main Matami
body:
Sajta hai chand, jaise sitaron k sath sath
Hai yun malak haram mein mazaro k sath sath
Hota hai karbala mein munawar jo daakhela
Jannat bhi ghoomti hai zawaaro k sath sath
Matla -
Dil Main Hussain Hai Meri jaanat Hai Karbala
Sani -
Main Matami Hoon Fatima Zehra ke Laal Ka
1- Mushkil Koi Kareeb Nahi Ati Bhool Ke
Farsh e Aza Bechata Hoon Larab mere Ghar saya Fagan hai parcham e Abbas bawafa
Main Matami , Hoon Fatima Zehra ke Laal Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Is ke Siwa Hayat Mai Bus or Kuch Na Ho Is Puri Kainat Mai bus Or Kuch Na Ho
Majals Hussain Ke Ho Ya Matam Hussain ka
Main Matami , Hoon Fatima Zehra ke Laal Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Is se Bada Tou Koi Azadar He nahi
Kehte Hai Log Mujko Azadar e Shah E Deen
Mujpe Hai Khaas Khalq e Akbar Ke Hai ata
Main Matami , Hoon Fatima Zehra ke Laal Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ya Rab Dekha De Roza E Shabbir Ek Baar
Apne Lahoo Se seej Ke aa Mere Kir digaar
Guzara Jisne Kardiya Sehra e Nainawaan
Main Matami , Hoon Fatima Zehra ke Laal Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Gazi Ke Bazuwon Ka Main Kaise Bhulaun Gham
Jaise He Bazu Nehar Pe Uske Huwe Kalam
Sar Se Batool Zadi K Chene Gayi Rida
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Jab Tasnagi Rulati Us Tasnakaam Ke
Sabeel main banata hoon Asgar Ke Naam Ke l
Farwa Ka Tukde Tukde Pisar Bhul Ta Nahi
Taza Rahega Unhe Bahatar Ka Gham Sada
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Mujko Rulate Bain Yahe Dilfigaar k
Dete Sakinaa Baliyaan Khud He Utar K
Aa Kash Usko Shimr Tamache Na Maar Ta
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Zindan Mai Manake Gham Shah e Masrakaan
Majlis Bapa Ke Or Kiya Matam Hussain ka
Ahsaan Humpe Sani E Zehra Ne Kardiya
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Ahle Aza Ke Dil Ke Hai Jawwad Ye Dua
Ta Hasr Us Hussain Ka Matam Rahe Bapa
Sar Deke Jis Hussain Ne Deen Ko Bachaliya
